asset.name: TopBar
asset.description: The application-level toolbar for navigation, search, global actions, status, and account controls, with responsive overflow and single-line chrome discipline.

requires.reason: Sizing, spacing, radius, and layer order resolve to declared ramps.
Layout uses the shared spacing ramp.
User-facing copy resolves through the adopting host locale bridge.

suggests.reason: A search affordance in the bar usually opens the palette, though a local filter may not.

deprecation.reason: An inline-style placeholder whose only job in generated scenarios was to hold a theme select; AppShell 2 has an optional header slot for products that need a strip and spends no chrome otherwise.
deprecation.migration: Move header content into AppShell 2's header prop, or delete the strip and put preferences in Settings.
